title: Expected Value Calculator
description: Compute expected value, variance and standard deviation from an outcomes × probabilities table with automatic probability-sum validation.
howto: Add one row per outcome: the value and its probability.
Use Add row / Remove to adjust the table; probabilities must be between 0 and 1.
Press Calculate — the tool checks the probabilities sum to 1.
Read E(X), variance and standard deviation with the term-by-term sum.

faqs.a: E(X) = Σ xᵢ·pᵢ: each outcome weighted by its probability. It is the long-run average if the experiment were repeated many times.

faqs.q: Do the probabilities have to sum to 1?
faqs.a: Yes — they must describe a complete distribution. The tool refuses to compute otherwise and shows the current sum.

faqs.q: What do variance and standard deviation add?
faqs.a: Variance Var(X) = Σ pᵢ(xᵢ − μ)² measures spread around the mean; the standard deviation is its square root, in the same units as the outcomes.
